About LibreScienceTools

Making scientific tools accessible to everyone

My Mission

LibreScienceTool is my personal project dedicated to providing open source software and open hardware to the engineering science community. Having benefited immensely from open source projects throughout my career, this initiative is my way of giving back.

I believe that scientific tools, knowledge, and instrumentation should be freely accessible to researchers, students, and enthusiasts worldwide, regardless of their institutional resources or geographic location.

What I Provide

  • Open Source Software: I develop and maintain software tools for data analysis, visualization, and scientific computing
  • Open Hardware: I design and share schematics for scientific instruments and laboratory equipment
  • Documentation & Tutorials: I provide comprehensive guides to help others build and use these tools

Support the Project

This is a one-person project maintained in my spare time. If you find these tools useful and want to support continued development, donations are appreciated but never required. The software will always remain free and open source. I have to check what licence is the most suitable though.
